name: R & R Catamaran Cruising Barbados
summary: A husband and wife team, Ryan and Rebecca Pitcher, sailing a 47ft catamaran called Second Chance from Port St. Charles Marina on the west coast. The site lists lunch, sunset and dinner cruises, small group sails and private charters.
standouts: Skipper Ryan completed his sailing training in the UK with the RYA
47ft sailing catamaran with four air-conditioned double cabins

contact.address: Port St. Charles Marina, St. Peter

checkNotes: Looks closed: nothing on the site is newer than 2019. Every page footer reads "©2018"; the sitemap lists every page as last modified 2019-03-08; the newest blog post is dated 10/31/2016. Prices carry no year, there is no booking page (only an enquiry form) and no 2025 or 2026 dates anywhere. For reference, the cruises-and-rates page lists a lunch cruise (Adults $135, Children $75, US dollars), sunset cruise (Adults $90, Children $50), dinner cruise (Adults $135, Children $75), a Cliff and Cliff Beach Club sunset cruise (Adults $90, Children $50) and private charter at $275 per hour, minimum 2 hours. They carry no date and were not built into trips because the site looks abandoned. The lunch cruise text advertises swimming with turtles but not feeding.
